title: Lady Bug Walk
description: Interactive simulation for Lady Bug Walk
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Lady
learningObjectives: Explain how turtle-graphics commands (move forward, rotate, branch) let a walking ladybug trace out a recursive tree
Trace the order in which branches are drawn as the ladybug walks out to a leaf and backtracks to the next branch
Predict how raising the depth slider from 1 to 10 changes the number of branches and the time needed to complete the walk
Distinguish the animation speed slider, which changes only how fast the ladybug moves, from the depth slider, which changes the structure drawn
Identify the recursive call in generateTreeCommands() that produces each child branch at a reduced length and rotated angle
